ShortDescription.Value: Ban public street parking without tedious work. Pick per District, or use the single road button even for 1-way alleys.

Publish.LongDescription:
## 🅿️ Parking Control (PC)
Want clean curbs without changing your road design?
* Easy to use; prevents cars and motorcycles from choosing public street parking. * No need to add grass or wide sidewalks as workarounds. * Ban parking on single roads, 1-way alleys, with the **No Parking** road button! * Manual no parking button is located in Road tools next to the Crosswalks button.
**Mod of the Month**: [video here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=keGjw8IzOOA)
## Choose where
Dropdown list in Options menu.
* **by District** recommended and the most versatile. It allows you to pick any whole district you want to ban parking in OR still use the manual no parking button on single roads or multi-selected roads.
* **Whole City** prevent street parking city-wide. Make sure the city has enough parking storage off street.
* **Manual Only** allows use of single road **No Parking** button, but removes the district parking policy. Picking this auto-disables any previous district no parking policy you enabled before (this mod's specific district no parking policy does not appear).
### Manual single roads
Use the **No Parking** button next to the Crosswalks button.
* **Left-click** a road to add No Parking. * **Right-click** to remove it.
Parking lots and building parking stay working normally.
Optional Status rows show parking usage with more detail than the game's info view.
## Good to know
* Make sure your city has enough off-street parking. When parking is unavailable, the game may use outside-connection storage or staging as it does in vanilla. * Some vanilla roads already don't allow parking, such as 3-lane small roads, highways, and 2-way alleys. * New or rebuilt roads may briefly accept a few cars while CS2 updates their parking lanes. * Safe to remove anytime and designed to not impact performance. * Optional 4-lane and 6-lane road parking bans work in addition to the main dropdown choice.
## Support and Feedback * Easiest way to support is click the LIKE 👍 button (top right). No donations requested. * Feedback and PRs are welcome through the GitHub and Discord links on the right.
**Planned:** centralized parking-fee controls.
## Credits and Thanks
* River-mochi - mod author * yenyang - technical consultant * Dataknase, Maintyper, DragonFire - testing * StarQ - no parking icon
## Languages English, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어, Polski, Português Brasileiro, ไทย Thai, Türkçe, Tiếng Việt, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Українська
## How does it work
* The mod uses the game's own ParkingDisabled flag on eligible roads. * It does not narrow the road, widen the sidewalk, or add a driving lane. The road looks the same. * Existing parked cars gradually relocate after parking is banned. * New or rebuilt roads may briefly accept a few cars while CS2 updates their parking lanes. * Optional: works with [Mochi's Hover Colors](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/146044/Windows). The manual road tool follows MHC's Bulldozer + Roads colors, just like normal road tools. * Manual No Parking is set per road segment. If you draw a road or train track perpendicular across a no-parking road, the game splits it into two new segments. Re-apply No Parking to the new halves. District and whole-city road-size bans are not affected by road splits.
